recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-41846 unless the work group opens a new issue to rename the normative element or choose different wording.
issue_request: FHIR-41846 asked to rename ElementDefinition.requirements to purpose because the old short display, "Why this resource has been created," sounded like a reason/purpose field and did not fit an element-level definition. The final Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution kept the normative element name and changed the short display to "Requirements satisfied by this element/structure and its constraints."
initial_application: Commit 28e721e2d771a64b80772835853b8b8b218c8429, titled "FHIR-41846 Rename ElementDefinition.requirements," applied the issue on 2025-03-03 by changing source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from the old short to the current replacement wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps elementdefinition to the ElementDefinition datatype page and marks ElementDefinition normative, making source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml the current build-scope source. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-03-18 record the same replacement text and a 12-0-0 motion to accept. The later related FHIR-49734 reconciliation is already on the combined branch and supports leaving the current FHIR-41846 wording unchanged.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because the active source already contains the exact FHIR-41846 replacement wording, and searches found no remaining instance of the old "Why this resource has been created" short in source.
